mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND layer_status = 'IMPORTING'

mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY' AND l.data_set_id = #{dataSetId} ORDER BY l.id DESC
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY'
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY' FOR UPDATE OF l
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l SET feature_count = s.total, geographic_extent = CASE WHEN s.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID(s.bounds::geometry,4326) END, geometry_types = COALESCE(s.types, '[]'::jsonb), data_version = l.data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total, ST_Extent(geom) AS bounds, jsonb_agg(DISTINCT GeometryType(geom) ORDER BY GeometryType(geom)) AS types FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature WHERE layer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) s WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET deleted = 1, source_file_id = NULL, data_version = data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

mapper.sql: WITH layer_kinds AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT jsonb_exists_any(geometry_types,ARRAY['POINT','MULTIPOINT','GEOMETRYCOLLECTION']) AS has_points, jsonb_exists(geometry_types,'GEOMETRYCOLLECTION') AS has_collections FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE id=#{layerId} ), settings AS NOT MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y}) AS tile_box, 40075016.68557849 / (power(2.0,#{z}) * 256.0) AS resolution, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-85.0511287798066,180,85.0511287798066,4326) AS world_geo, ST_TileEnvelope(0,0,0) AS world_box ), bounds AS NOT MATERIALIZED ( SELECT expanded.*, ST_Transform(query_box,4326) AS query_geo FROM ( SELECT *, ST_Intersection(ST_Expand(tile_box, ceil(GREATEST(#{bufferPixels},#{gridPixels})::numeric / #{gridPixels}) * #{gridPixels} * resolution), world_box) AS query_box FROM settings ) expanded ), candidates AS NOT MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.id, f.properties, f.geom FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE f.layer_id = #{layerId} AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.geom && b.query_geo ), parts AS NOT MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id,properties,geom,'/geometry'::text AS geometry_path FROM candidates WHERE ST_GeometryType(geom)!='ST_GeometryCollection' UNION ALL SELECT c.id,c.properties,child.geom,child.geometry_path FROM candidates c CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( WITH RECURSIVE nested(geom,geometry_path) AS ( SELECT c.geom,'/geometry'::text UNION ALL SELECT ST_GeometryN(p.geom,n),p.geometry_path || '/geometries/' || (n - 1)::text FROM nested p CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, CASE WHEN ST_GeometryType(p.geom)='ST_GeometryCollection' THEN ST_NumGeometries(p.geom) ELSE 0 END) AS n ) SELECT geom,geometry_path FROM nested WHERE ST_GeometryType(geom)!='ST_GeometryCollection' ) child WHERE (SELECT has_collections FROM layer_kinds) AND ST_GeometryType(c.geom)='ST_GeometryCollection' ), leaves AS NOT MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p.id,p.geometry_path, CASE WHEN ST_Dimension(p.geom)=0 THEN 'POINT' WHEN ST_Dimension(p.geom)=1 THEN 'LINE' ELSE 'POLYGON' END AS category, CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(CAST(#{fieldsJson} AS jsonb))=0 THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(field.name,p.properties->field.name) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{fieldsJson} AS jsonb)) AS field(name) WHERE jsonb_typeof(p.properties)='object' AND jsonb_exists(p.properties,field.name)), '{}'::jsonb) END AS props, ST_Transform(CASE WHEN p.geom @ b.world_geo THEN ST_Force2D(p.geom) ELSE ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Intersection(ST_Force2D(p.geom),b.world_geo),ST_Dimension(p.geom)+1) END,3857) AS geom FROM parts p CROSS JOIN bounds b ), point_cells AS ( SELECT l.id,l.geometry_path,l.props,d.path::text AS point_path,d.geom, LEAST((power(2.0,#{z}) * 256 / #{gridPixels})::bigint-1, GREATEST(0,floor((ST_X(d.geom)+20037508.342789244)/(b.resolution * #{gridPixels}))::bigint)) AS cell_x, LEAST((power(2.0,#{z}) * 256 / #{gridPixels})::bigint-1, GREATEST(0,floor((20037508.342789244-ST_Y(d.geom))/(b.resolution * #{gridPixels}))::bigint)) AS cell_y FROM leaves l CROSS JOIN bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_DumpPoints(l.geom) d WHERE (SELECT has_points FROM layer_kinds) AND l.category='POINT' AND ST_Intersects(d.geom,b.query_box) )

, point_buckets AS ( SELECT *,CASE WHEN #{aggregate} THEN '' ELSE id::text || ':' || geometry_path || ':' || point_path END AS bucket FROM point_cells ), point_groups AS ( SELECT cell_x,cell_y,props,bucket, min(id) AS feature_id,min(geometry_path) AS geometry_path, count(*) AS point_count,count(DISTINCT id) AS feature_count, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(avg(ST_X(geom)),avg(ST_Y(geom))),3857) AS geom FROM point_buckets GROUP BY cell_x,cell_y,props,bucket ), point_shapes AS ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN point_count > 1 THEN #{z}::text || ':' || cell_x::text || ':' || cell_y::text || ':' || encode(sha256(convert_to(props::text,'UTF8')),'hex') END AS cluster_id FROM point_groups )

, shapes AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN point_count > 1 THEN 'cluster' ELSE 'feature' END AS "_vector_kind", CASE WHEN point_count=1 THEN feature_id::text END AS "_vector_feature_id", CASE WHEN point_count=1 THEN geometry_path END AS "_vector_geometry_path", CASE WHEN point_count > 1 THEN cluster_id ELSE feature_id::text || ':' || geometry_path || ':' || cell_x::text || ':' || cell_y::text || ':' || bucket END AS "_vector_part_id", CASE WHEN point_count > 1 THEN cluster_id END AS "_vector_cluster_id", 'POINT'::text AS "_vector_category",props::text AS "_vector_properties", point_count::text AS "_vector_count",feature_count::text AS "_vector_feature_count",geom FROM point_shapes UNION ALL SELECT 'feature',id::text,geometry_path,id::text || ':' || geometry_path,NULL, category,props::text,NULL,NULL, CASE WHEN category='LINE' THEN ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(geom,b.resolution * 0.5) ELSE geom END FROM leaves CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE category!='POINT' ), clipped AS ( SELECT s.*,m.tile_geom FROM shapes s CROSS JOIN bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(s.geom,b.tile_box,4096,#{bufferPixels} * 16,true) AS tile_geom OFFSET 0 ) m ), encoded AS ( SELECT "_vector_kind","_vector_feature_id","_vector_geometry_path","_vector_part_id","_vector_cluster_id", "_vector_category","_vector_properties","_vector_count","_vector_feature_count",tile_geom AS geom FROM clipped WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(tile_geom) AND ST_GeometryType(tile_geom)!='ST_GeometryCollection' AND ST_Dimension(tile_geom)=CASE "_vector_category" WHEN 'POINT' THEN 0 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ), tile AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ST_AsMVT(encoded,'features',4096,'geom'),''::bytea) AS body FROM encoded ) SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body) <= #{maxBytes} THEN body END AS body,octet_length(body)::bigint AS byte_size FROM tile
